title: Complex threefolds from marked torus families
objective: Teach the complete S6 construction and its retained refinements through exact arguments and checked prerequisite providers.
sequence_kind: Finite working sequence; dependency comparison may move a unit without changing the full assignment.

lessons.title: Two finite torus quotients and their line bundles
lessons.proof_scope: Original period matrices, full integral fixed and moving lattices, exact product kernels, free groups of orders nine and eight, and explicit smooth trivializations of holomorphically torsion line bundles.

lessons.title: Normal boundaries and their integral maps
lessons.proof_scope: Full deck groups, exact central attachment kernel, explicit product-group isomorphism, integral H1 and covering pullback H1 with indices three and four.

lessons.title: Varying finite fillings and every base-change branch
lessons.proof_scope: All local period germs and their exact inverse parametrization, original covariance, proper finite quotient, complete real-analytic normal-bundle comparison, all normalization branches and branch-independent punctured holomorphic conjugacy.
antecedents: candidate_geometry.tex period cocycles and finite-filling proposition

lessons.title: Global periods and the line-bundle quotient
lessons.proof_scope: Global cusp-regular period construction, exact admissible constant range, all fibre line-bundle quotient maps, exact contraction rate, full Weierstrass scale map and explicit rational parametrization.

lessons.title: The cusp and the compact threefold
lessons.proof_scope: Complete unit-dependent cusp model, normalization, properness and compact gluing; rational-section generator, full finite resolutions, exact heights, global translation and every factor in the line-bundle lift comparison.

lessons.title: Integral monodromy and the fundamental group
lessons.proof_scope: Every original integral monodromy and exterior-power lattice, complete based finite and cusp kernels, full van Kampen proof, exact Engel marking dictionary, and actual additional free affine fillings with their cyclic fundamental groups.

lessons.title: Integral homology and smooth sphere recognition
lessons.proof_scope: Exact integral homology computation, homotopy equivalence and smooth recognition with proved or exact preceding providers for each topological result.
lessons.integral_parity_step: Closed by the exact smooth line-bundle lift, integer norm equation and retained constant phases; no Wu-class input is needed for this specialization lattice.
lessons.integral_duality_step: Complete compact-support integer duality, finite generation and perfect free pairing included. Exact covering comparison strengthens the degree-three index to both full image lattices.
lessons.cw_hurewicz_step: Explicit nested-cube telescope and both manifold comparison maps, including the original punctured cobordism; full coherent-simplex first Hurewicz theorem and the positive sphere class.
lessons.path_fibre_step: Complete path lifting and homotopy sequence; filtered integer chains and both Serre edges; CW-domain compression and inverse maps for the original degree-one sphere map and two boundary inclusions.
lessons.framed_whitney_disk_step: Complete original-radius complement diffeomorphism and tangent maps; relative embedded disk avoiding the retained collar strata; full nonorthogonal frame criterion; actual corner boundary, both orientation signs and adapted framed disk for the specified simply connected handle stage. The ambient move is proved in its included companion; original handle reduction remains.
lessons.supported_whitney_move_step: Complete collar-germ extension and original corner-disk comparison; exact simultaneous sheet coordinates; full cutoff flow, signs, support and inverse; transport of all original framed tubes with every radius retained; diffeomorphism of attached cobordisms fixing the incoming boundary. The original handle reduction and smooth sphere-group calculation remain.
lessons.original_handle_decomposition_step: Relative Morse function on the original cobordism with whole fixed boundary collars; full-Hessian coordinate comparison and original metric; exact level maps with their exceptional sets; actual framed handle insertion, complete transverse seam, specified outward rounding and variable-time collar absorption; all critical indices and final outgoing identification retained. The index arrangement is proved in its included companion; low-index removal, full reduction and the smooth sphere-group calculation remain.
lessons.original_handle_index_arrangement_step: Exact comparison of the retained rounded boundary and original surgery collars, with both full endpoint germs and both radial derivatives; compression of the entire next framed tube; supported outward motion through the actual core-complement map; explicit collar extension and literal interchange of disjoint attached pieces; all extreme indices, parameter radii, later frames and final outgoing identification retained. Low-index removal and full handle cancellation remain.
lessons.original_morse_trajectory_step: Entire boundary isotopy realized as descending holonomy with full framing and metric derivatives; exact stable-belt comparison; compact embedded escaping unstable disk; global disk coordinates retaining every original Hessian coefficient; explicit supported critical-value lowering with strictly positive transverse derivative brackets; actual ordered Morse function and its complete comparison to the original handle presentation. The initial and final fields, all boundary collars and both extreme indices are accounted for. Low-index removal and cancellation remain.
lessons.original_zero_top_removal_step: Actual index-one branch arrangement by supported holonomy; stable-level measure-zero proof; exact correspondence between cobordism components and the trajectory graph; complete boundary-to-minimum cancellation and finite zero-index removal; original negative function, all Hessian coefficients, coordinate permutation signs and both collar maps retained in top-index removal; full comparison of the entire handle presentations. Only connectedness is required for this step. Index-one removal and the middle reduction remain.
lessons.original_handle_pair_creation_step: Complete explicit two-critical-point model, compactly supported cancellation with all derivative bounds, global lower-level parametrization and complete horizontal product with exact inverse, supported single birth path, unique transverse connecting trajectory and compact full truncated unstable set, implantation in the original regular band with all coordinate scales and metric data, and actual lower attaching sphere bounding its framed disk. Supplies index-two/three stabilization in dimensions six and seven. Slides, index-one removal, middle reduction and Theta6 remain.
lessons.original_framed_slide_and_index_one_step: Complete original based group and finite normal-closure calculation; actual supported framed belt crossing with its negative relator sign and retained conjugator; relative loop isotopy with full ambient and framing extension; simultaneous old critical level; exact original descending map including every Hessian coefficient, radius and variable-time derivative; verified one/two cancellation, full transport of the retained three-handle and finite reversed removal. Proves the stronger surjectivity hypothesis for the actual boundary fundamental-group map. Middle-index incidence reduction, higher-index framed slides, Whitney cancellations and Theta6 remain.
lessons.current_remaining_smooth_prerequisites: Geometric realization of the original higher-index chain operations by full framed slides, middle Whitney and trajectory cancellations, and the complete smooth six-sphere-group calculation.
lessons.original_integral_handle_chain_step: Complete original relative-handle filtration, singular-homology comparison, signed incidence with retained chart and boundary signs, ordinary integral extension without ambient orientability, full adjacent integer basis changes, unit contraction with every correction term, and complete original-coordinate contractions in receiving dimensions six and seven. Higher-index geometric slides, middle Whitney cancellations and Theta6 remain.

lessons.title: Canonical sections and the intrinsic fibration
lessons.proof_scope: Exact Hodge-line extension, evaluation divisor, all signed vertical direct images, full graded ring, recovered fibration and every preserved multiple fibre; four solved exercises.

lessons.title: Periods and nontrivial deformation
lessons.proof_scope: Full proper parameter family, exact marked real and Beltrami maps, nonzero fibre and global deformation classes, every possible linear part, exact finite parity obstruction, global even-shift maps and complete quotient parameter.

lessons.title: Non-normal fibres and the vanishing calculation
lessons.proof_scope: Complete conormal and intrinsic torsion maps, proper test family, full-fibre duality/base change, every analytic twist, full index polynomial, global nonvanishing and exact source corrections; three complete analytical companion chapters and six solved exercises.

lessons.title: Almost complex spheres and the complex-geometry background
lessons.proof_scope: Full octonion comparison, Nijenhuis and associator maps, complete smooth integrability proof, polynomial Bott generation and sphere restriction, with all receiving characteristic-class proofs included.

gaussian_channel_material: Retained separately; not a provider for the sphere-recognition theorem.
review: Each authored proof is checked on its own terms. A source's stated theorem or a symbolic test is not whole-source certification.
